tools.name: cobot_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the signed-in Cobot user, and the spaces they administer or belong to. Use this first to find a space id. Cobot API: GET /user.

tools.name: cobot_get_space
tools.description: Get one space by id. Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}.

tools.name: cobot_get_space_subscription
tools.description: Get the space's Cobot subscription. Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/subscription.

tools.name: cobot_list_memberships
tools.description: List the space's memberships in a date range (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/memberships.

tools.name: cobot_search_memberships
tools.description: Search the space's current memberships by text (admins only), such as a name, company or email. Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/memberships/search.

tools.name: cobot_get_membership
tools.description: Get one membership by id. Admins of the space and the member themselves can read it. Cobot API: GET /memberships/{id}.

tools.name: cobot_list_membership_plans
tools.description: List the plan history of a space in a date range: each membership's plans while it was active. Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/membership_plans.

tools.name: cobot_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams of a space (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/teams.

tools.name: cobot_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of a space (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/contacts.

tools.name: cobot_search_contacts
tools.description: Search the space's contacts by name, email, company or tag (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/contacts/search.

tools.name: cobot_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id (admins only). Cobot API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: cobot_list_invoices
tools.description: List the space's invoices, filtered by member, date range, date field or paid status (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/invoices.

tools.name: cobot_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id (admins only). Cobot API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: cobot_list_products
tools.description: List the products a space sells for bookings or external bookings. Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/products.

tools.name: cobot_list_resources
tools.description: List the space's resources, filtered by usage. Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/resources.

tools.name: cobot_get_resource_availability
tools.description: Get when one resource is free in a time range. Cobot API: GET /resources/{id}/availability.

tools.name: cobot_list_bookings
tools.description: List the bookings of a space in a time range (admins and members). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/bookings.

tools.name: cobot_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id. Cobot API: GET /bookings/{id}.

tools.name: cobot_list_events
tools.description: List a space's events in a time range, published and/or draft (drafts are admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/events.

tools.name: cobot_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id. Cobot API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: cobot_list_event_attendances
tools.description: List who attends an event. Cobot API: GET /events/{id}/attendances.

tools.name: cobot_list_check_ins
tools.description: List one membership's check-ins that start in a time range. Cobot API: GET /memberships/{membershipId}/check_ins.

tools.name: cobot_list_current_check_ins
tools.description: List the check-ins still valid for the membership that owns a check-in token (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/check_ins/current.

tools.name: cobot_list_booking_credits
tools.description: List one membership's booking credits. Cobot API: GET /memberships/{membershipId}/booking_credits.

tools.name: cobot_list_drop_in_passes
tools.description: List the space's drop-in passes valid in a date range (admins only). Cobot API: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/drop_in_passes.

tools.name: cobot_check_in_membership
tools.description: Check a member in at a space with their check-in token. Fails when the membership is paused or a rule blocks it. Cobot API: POST /check_ins.

tools.name: cobot_check_out_membership
tools.description: Check out a membership that is checked in at a space (admins only). Cobot API: PUT /check_ins/{id}/check_out.

tools.name: cobot_book_resource_as_member
tools.description: Book a resource for a membership. Creates a booking for the membership. Cobot API: POST /memberships/{membershipId}/bookings.

tools.name: cobot_create_issue
tools.description: Open a help desk issue in a space (for a fault or request). Members open it as themselves; admins open it as the admin. Cobot API: POST /issues.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cobot_search_memberships, cobot_search_contacts, cobot_check_in_membership, cobot_create_issue · Private data: cobot_list_contacts, cobot_search_contacts, cobot_get_contact, cobot_list_current_check_ins, cobot_check_in_membership · Public sink: cobot_search_memberships, cobot_search_contacts, cobot_check_in_membership, cobot_book_resource_as_member, cobot_create_issue · Destructive: cobot_list_drop_in_passes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cobot_search_memberships, cobot_search_contacts, cobot_check_in_membership, cobot_create_issue · Private data: cobot_list_contacts, cobot_search_contacts, cobot_get_contact, cobot_list_current_check_ins, cobot_check_in_membership · Public sink: cobot_search_memberships, cobot_search_contacts, cobot_check_in_membership, cobot_book_resource_as_member, cobot_create_issue · Destructive: cobot_list_drop_in_passes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
